description: This PHP test class, ChartDaoTest, is part of the OrangeHRM project and contains unit tests for the ChartDao class within the Dashboard Data Access Object (DAO) layer. It sets up test data and verifies functionalities such as employee count retrieval and distribution by subunit and location.

classes.name: ChartDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the ChartDao data access object within the OrangeHRM Dashboard module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of ChartDao, and populates test data from a fixture file.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeCount
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of unassigned employee count with and without subunit filter.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeDistributionBySubunit
methods.description: Verifies retrieval and structure of employee distribution data by subunit.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeDistributionByLocation
methods.description: Verifies retrieval and structure of employee distribution data by location.

methods.name: testGetTotalActiveEmployeeCount
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of total active employee count.
